Current milestone state — updated 2026-07-22 (fleet policy shipped; soak overdue).

VERSION: v1.2.2 SHIPPED stable 2026-06-09, Leg-C-verified (quality/perf pass, 9 refactor commits + 1 security fix: import confirm-value tripwire). GHSA-hf25-j9h5-5vq5 published 2026-06-10 for the v1.2.1 RCE (see [[context.ghsaExecOnRead]]). Channels: rvr stable 1.2.2, rvr-beta (1.0.0-beta.3), rvr-dev.

FLEET (2026-07-22): all shell agents (fable=Claude Code, sol=Codex) reach Reverie via rvr CLI only; MCP reserved for shell-less surfaces, app-level registration; repo .mcp.json removed, AGENTS.md is the single contract. Full policy + consequences: [[project.surfaceStrategy]] FLEET POLICY. MCP no longer gets ambient dogfooding — exercise it deliberately before releases.

SOAK: OVERDUE — clock pegged to v1.2.0 (2026-06-09); day-7 checkpoint 2026-06-16 and hard cap 2026-06-23 both passed with no eval. Per project.soakPolicy do NOT extend. Sequence now: (1) rewrite the EXIT GATE first — its '>=10 distinct MCP sessions' criterion is unsatisfiable under the fleet policy; (2) eval the 7d window ending 2026-06-23 leak-aware — discount #130 test traffic (~451 reverie_init writes inside the window) AND un-bridged CLI phantom sessions (no RVR_SESSION = one session per process); (3) theme-pick v1.3.0 Trust.

WATCHER FINDINGS (2026-06-10 audit-watcher experiment, docs/investigation-watcher-experiment-2026-06-10.md + [[project.twoRecordsThesis]] + [[context.auditRecordProperties]]): filed #134 (SKIP_AUDIT blind spot), #135 (audit watch mode), #136 (session retrospective) — #135/#136 are theme-candidates; thesis reframes v1.3.0 Trust as reconciliation-loops-over-the-log (attribution #45, coldness #84, topology may be QUERIES over audit.jsonl, not new metadata systems). Fleet work added two more Trust-shaped candidates: ambient agent detection from harness env fingerprints (feeds #45) and harness-free CLI session derivation (the #119 leftover).

RELEASE MAP: v1.3.0 Trust (#84 #42 #45 #130 #133 #134 #135 #136 candidates — pick at soak exit) / v1.4.0 Find (#13 #43 #47) / v1.5.0 Reach (#50 #6 #49) / v1.6.0 Share (#115) / v1.7.0 Scale (#44 #48) / v1.8.0 Surfaces (#51) / v2.0.0 (#128, Sept 2027). v1.4+ ordering soft.

TIER-3 REFACTOR BACKLOG (file issues first): import-pipeline unification (fixes #133), rename/copy core, paths.ts walk dedup, registerTool migration (22 deprecations), load() snapshot memo.

NON-ENGINEERING (not issue-tracked): commercial GTM ([[project.commercialContext]]), launch comms, visual identity. Watcher experiment is dogfooding case-study material.
